# Added 2026-08-15, with the reviewer agreeing in this change, as the header requires.
#
# These are the v3 and current-v4 room bundles, fetched from the reference's public site and
# committed as SHA-256 pinned evidence. They carry personal data for the same reason the line above
# does: the reference ships one email address inside its own JavaScript, and we are storing that
# JavaScript byte-for-byte because every decode cites offsets into it.
#
# VERIFIED BEFORE ADDING, not assumed: all three bundles contain exactly ONE unique address and it
# is the SAME one in each -- compared by SHA-256 of the address rather than by printing it. So this
# is not new personal data entering the repository; it is the already-accepted value appearing in
# two more copies of the same artifact.
#
# `--update` was deliberately NOT used, because the header says to run it only after REMOVING data.
# These lines are hand-written so the reasoning above travels with them.
#
# Redacting the bundles is not an option: they are hash-pinned by `dump-contract.test.ts`, every
# decoded document cites byte offsets into them, and `CLAUDE.md` forbids reformatting anything in a
# capture directory. Removing them would delete the evidence the project is built against.
